I farm 9 mu here in Quzhou, and I have done wheat-maize every year for 40 years. Let me think through what I will do this season, same as always with a few small changes.

**My wheat (winter, planted last October on all 9 mu):**
I planted Jimai variety again — improved seed, the agro-dealer in town sold me the same one my neighbor Old Zhang used, he got over 500 jin per mu last year. Before planting I put down compound fertilizer, about 50 jin per mu (that 15-15-15 bag). Now in spring, at jointing time, I will topdress urea — about 30 jin per mu, that's roughly 14 kg of nitrogen from that application alone. Total nitrogen across the season I figure around 18 kg per mu, maybe a bit more. My father always said wheat eats nitrogen, and if I skimp I lose yield — better to put a little extra. Phosphorus about 8 kg per mu from the base fertilizer, potassium around 6 kg. Our soil here is not bad, but wheat still needs it.

Irrigation: I have well water, so I irrigate 4 times — winter water before freeze, then green-up water in March, jointing water, and filling water in May. If the spring rain is good I might skip one, but usually 4 is what I do. Spray pesticide 2 times — once for aphids and once mixed spray for rust and aphids near heading. Tillage: I use rotary tiller, everyone around here does, ploughing deep is too expensive to hire.

Expected wheat yield: about 480 kg per mu. That's what I usually get.

**My maize (summer, after wheat harvest in June):**
Same 9 mu, plant hybrid maize — Zhengdan or similar, the dealer rotates what he stocks. Hybrid seed is more expensive but you cannot grow maize here without it anymore, nobody saves their own. No tillage after wheat — I just use the seeder directly into the stubble, saves money and time, and the moisture stays in the soil. Everyone does this now.

Fertilizer for maize: I put compound fertilizer at planting, about 40 jin per mu, then side-dress urea at big trumpet stage, maybe 25 jin per mu. Total nitrogen around 16 kg per mu. Phosphorus 6 kg, potassium 5 kg. Maize in summer with our rain does not need as much water as wheat — I irrigate once or twice if July is dry. Pesticide once or twice, mainly for corn borer.

Expected maize yield: about 550 kg per mu. Good years I get 600.

My family has 7 people, some work in town so money comes in, but I still watch every yuan of fertilizer. I do not experiment — what works, I keep doing.
